authorities.Q2 public_api: a shipped public header of the component declares the vulnerable function, so it is externally callable without any call-graph reasoning
authorities.Q2 not_shipped: the vulnerable function exists only under test/, fuzz/, examples/ or docs/, which are not installed
authorities.Q3 cvss_vector: NVD CVSS v3 AV/UI: UI:N with AV in {N,A,L}

one_sided_by_construction: Neither authority can produce the opposite label. A public header says nothing about whether an INTERNAL function is unreachable, because the public functions call it; and CVSS UI:R does not mean the triggering value is not attacker-chosen. So Q2 has a negative class only from the build layout (not_shipped) and Q3 has none at all: a Q3 refutation is unmeasurable against any public authority, which is also why vex_judge_v2 must never let Q3 refute.
